questions.question: [Demo] What is innovation?
options: Turning a useful idea into value
questions.explanation: Innovation puts ideas into practice to create value.

questions.question: [Demo] Why build a prototype?
questions.explanation: A prototype helps you learn before investing in a full solution.

questions.question: [Demo] What is a good first step for a new business idea?
questions.explanation: Understanding a real problem helps you design something people need.

questions.question: [Demo] What does customer feedback help you do?
questions.explanation: Feedback reveals what works and what needs to change.

questions.question: [Demo] What is an entrepreneur?
options: Someone who creates and develops a venture
Only someone with a large office
questions.explanation: Entrepreneurs develop ventures by bringing together ideas, resources and action.

questions.question: [Demo] What is a value proposition?
options: The benefit you offer to a customer
questions.explanation: It explains why your solution is useful to the people you serve.

questions.question: [Demo] Which habit supports creative teamwork?
questions.explanation: Different perspectives help teams discover more possibilities.

questions.question: [Demo] What should you do after an experiment fails?
questions.explanation: Experiments provide useful learning even when a result is unexpected.

questions.question: [Demo] What does a sustainable solution consider?
questions.explanation: Sustainability considers how a solution affects people and the environment over time.

questions.question: [Demo] Why start with a small pilot?
questions.explanation: A small pilot lets you test assumptions before expanding.
